Message:
sched/core: Fix cpu.max vs. cpuhotplug deadlock

Tejun reported the following cpu-hotplug lock (percpu-rwsem) read recursion:

  tg_set_cfs_bandwidth()
    get_online_cpus()
      cpus_read_lock()

    cfs_bandwidth_usage_inc()
      static_key_slow_inc()
        cpus_read_lock()
